name: vibebackr
title: VibeBackr
tagline: turn what you build in AI chat into a real app anyone can use
description: Give any tool you build in Claude or ChatGPT its own live web link, Google sign-in, and cloud memory that stays saved - zero coding or servers required.
features: Instant live web address (your-app.vibebac.kr) for any AI-built tool
Permanent cloud memory that stays saved across phones and laptops
1-click Google & GitHub sign-in with zero setup
Private, email-shared (with auto-invites), or public access
Team workspaces and automatic manager access for work tools
1-click Claude extension & works with ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor
